threadTarget.description: Immutable semantic target captured when a thread delivery is created.

threadId.description:
Canonical target persisted by Gateway. Callers provide this only for
`ExactThread`; for semantic targets it is server-owned output.

threadTarget.description:
Required for `Thread` delivery. Gateway resolves semantic targets to a
canonical `thread_id` before persisting the Task.

TaskDeliveryThreadTarget.description: Semantic thread target resolved and persisted by Gateway.

oneOf.description:
Compatibility default for pre-Epic-6 persisted and wire values. New
user-thread creation selects `Message` explicitly.

effort.description:
String-valued because CLI runtimes may advertise efforts newer than
Pioneer API-provider adapters understand.
